line: Modern soldiers have a new strategy.
QR codes on their tanks. On every panel. Every hatch. Even the barrel.
So when enemy drones scan one... it takes them straight to...
Sora. QR table ordering for South African restaurants.
Guests order at the table, and the kitchen sees it instantly.
Call a waiter with one tap. No app to download.
We're choosing our founding restaurants. Only five spots.
Join the waitlist at sora Q R dot co dot za.
